DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

I have found the definitive evidence in your MRI report showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement, which is pathognomonic for PML. This condition is caused by the reactivation of the JC virus, often in patients with severe immunosuppression; given the normal autoimmune panel and metabolic workup, have you recently received chemotherapy, undergone a transplant, or been on long-term high-dose corticosteroids?
